description: This file contains utility functions and a class for estimating and reporting the Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for processing tasks, including time formatting, progress prediction, and logging ETA updates.

classes.name: ETA
classes.description: Class to predict and estimate remaining time for a process based on progress data.

methods.name: human_time
methods.description: Converts a timedelta or seconds into a human-readable string with appropriate units.

methods.name: eta
methods.description: Generator function that yields data from an iterator while periodically logging ETA updates.

methods.name: ETA.__init__
methods.description: Initializes ETA object with total expected items.

methods.name: ETA.human_time
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the estimated remaining time and rate.

methods.name: ETA.update
methods.description: Updates the ETA with the current progress count.

methods.name: ETA.needReport
methods.description: Determines if enough time has passed to report ETA.

methods.name: ETA._calc
methods.description: Calculates the ETA based on recent progress data using Pearson correlation.
